summary: Backend APIs pass 5/5, while mobile preview loads and navigation/profile flows work. Proposal submit remains outside the 390x844 viewport and cannot be tapped reliably.

ui_bugs.issue: The proposal submit button reports y=907.67 on a 390x844 viewport and Playwright refuses the tap as outside the viewport; acceptance flow is therefore blocked.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify UI POST calls or banner because the submit control is not tappable in the public mobile preview.

issues: Sheet visually appears within the screenshot, but its layout box overflows below the viewport; ScrollView/maxHeight is not constraining the actionable content reliably.

action_items: Fix ProposalModalFixed layout so proposal-submit-button has a bounding box within the viewport and is tappable at 390x844; then retest UI POST /api/proposals, POST /api/proposals/{id}/accept, modal closure, and banner.
Verify CreateModal full four-step publish flow and chat UI send after proposal blocker is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API constant reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the environment contract in the review request names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current configured preview works, but naming should be made consistent.
Completion/rating UI is not present in index.tsx despite being part of the stated MVP flow; backend endpoints exist but no mobile controls were verified.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (load, bottom navigation, profile/dark mode pass; proposal acceptance blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_regression_order, TEST proposal, and TEST message through regression tests; no cleanup endpoints exist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview is healthy and backend persistence is verified. Proposal button is visually shown but its measured layout is below viewport; prioritize this before testing downstream acceptance/chat UI.
rca_of_issue: At 390x844, ProposalModalFixed's submit locator consistently returns bounding box y=907.67 despite the screenshot showing the button near the bottom of the sheet. The transparent Modal/sheet ScrollView combination is allowing native-web layout height to exceed the viewport. Playwright click fails with Element is outside of the viewport, so the accept handler never runs.
